issue_text: filterGeneratedGitContext and its helpers (filterGeneratedFiles, filterGeneratedDiff, filterGeneratedUntrackedExcerpts, isGeneratedDiffSection, isGeneratedMetareviewPath) implement the 'never review our own generated artifacts' exclusion, but no test in internal/taskdone feeds a .metareview/ or docs/metareview/ path through any git field and asserts it is removed. The only shardedTaskRepo fixture contains no generated-path content, so the filters always run over input with nothing to strip. filterGeneratedGitContext can be made a complete no-op (or filterGeneratedFiles' `if isGeneratedMetareviewPath(file) { continue }` can be inverted, which would drop every real file and keep only generated ones) and every test in the package still passes. The property is unpinned at this layer.
why_real: Mechanically invertible/deletable with all package tests green (verified: shardwiring_test.go's repo has only src/file*.txt + docs/tasks/big-task.md, review_markdown_test.go and mutationctx_test.go never call Create/filtering). The status package has its own isGeneratedMetareviewPath test (internal/status/branch_test.go:546) but that is a separate duplicate copy and does not exercise taskdone's filter functions. Severity is low because gitcontext.collect already applies the same exclusion globs to Diff/ChangedFiles/Staged/Untracked (gitcontext.go:121-137), so the production property is still enforced upstream and taskdone's copy is redundant belt-and-suspenders — but the redundancy is exactly why a break here is silent and untested.
tests_checked: internal/taskdone/shardwiring_test.go (all cases: fixture has no generated paths in the branch diff, exceptions==nil path runs filterGeneratedGitContext over clean input), review_markdown_test.go (calls contextMarkdown/reviewMarkdown directly, bypasses filtering), mutationctx_test.go (no filtering); confirmed no test references filterGenerated* / isGeneratedMetareviewPath in package; gitcontext.go:121-137 confirms upstream exclusion of the same fields.
